query.description: SODA query against any www.data.va.gov dataset (catalog alias or 4x4 id): VetPop veteran population, compensation and pension recipients and expenditures.

$where.desc: SoQL filter; quote text and dates: state = 'Texas' AND date = '2025-09-30'

$order.desc: SoQL order; default :id gives stable paging

csv.description: Same SODA query as CSV (for manual download in a browser).

gdx_state_direct.description: Geographic Distribution of VA Expenditures (GDX) workbook, sheet State Direct Exp: direct benefit expenditures by state (compensation & pension, DIC and survivors pension, insurance, specially adapted housing), dollars, FY25 layout

fy.desc: two-digit fiscal year of the GDX workbook, e.g. 25 (layout verified for FY25; other years differ)

gdx_state_indirect.description: GDX workbook, third sheet (State Indirect Exp): indirect expenditures by state (medical care: VA and community care, education, readiness & employment, loan guaranty, construction, memorial benefits, autos), dollars, FY25 layout

fy.desc: two-digit fiscal year of the GDX workbook, e.g. 25 (layout verified for FY25; other years differ)

gdx_county_direct.description: GDX workbook, sheet County Direct Exp: direct benefit expenditures by county, dollars

fy.desc: two-digit fiscal year of the GDX workbook, e.g. 25 (layout verified for FY25; other years differ)

gdx_county_indirect.description: GDX workbook, sheet County Indirect Exp: indirect expenditures (medical care, education, loan guaranty, ...) by county, dollars

fy.desc: two-digit fiscal year of the GDX workbook, e.g. 25 (layout verified for FY25; other years differ)

gdx_cd_direct.description: GDX workbook, sheet CD Direct Exp: direct benefit expenditures by congressional district (119th Congress in FY25), dollars

fy.desc: two-digit fiscal year of the GDX workbook, e.g. 25 (layout verified for FY25; other years differ)

gdx_cd_indirect.description: GDX workbook, sheet CD Indirect Exp: indirect expenditures by congressional district (119th Congress in FY25), dollars

fy.desc: two-digit fiscal year of the GDX workbook, e.g. 25 (layout verified for FY25; other years differ)

vetpop_national.name: VetPop2023 National Data, 1L
vetpop_national.description: VetPop2023 projection (base 2023-09-30), one row per September 30, 2023-2053, integers rounded per cell; national living veterans by sex and 15 age groups (date, age_group, sex, veterans)

vetpop_national_pos.name: VetPop2023 National Period of Service Data, 2L
vetpop_national_pos.description: VetPop2023 projection (base 2023-09-30), one row per September 30, 2023-2053, integers rounded per cell; national veterans by sex and period of service (period_of_service holds overlapping groups (a)-(x): never sum them)

vetpop_national_race.name: VetPop2023 National Race/Ethnicity Data, 3L
vetpop_national_race.description: VetPop2023 projection (base 2023-09-30), one row per September 30, 2023-2053, integers rounded per cell; national veterans by sex and race/ethnicity

vetpop_state.name: VetPop2023 State Data, 6L
vetpop_state.description: VetPop2023 projection (base 2023-09-30), one row per September 30, 2023-2053, integers rounded per cell; veterans by state (full names, plus Puerto Rico and 'Island Areas & Foreign'), sex and 15 age groups (date, state, age_group, sex, veterans); sum the rows for a state total

vetpop_state_pos.name: VetPop2023 State Period of Service Data, 7L
vetpop_state_pos.description: VetPop2023 projection (base 2023-09-30), one row per September 30, 2023-2053, integers rounded per cell; veterans by state, sex and period of service (column pos: overlapping groups (a)-(x); '(a) All Veterans (b+c)' is the total)

vetpop_state_race.name: VetPop2023 State Race/Ethnicity Data, 8L
vetpop_state_race.description: VetPop2023 projection (base 2023-09-30), one row per September 30, 2023-2053, integers rounded per cell; veterans by state, sex and race/ethnicity (race_ethnicity 'All Veterans' is the total)

vetpop_county.name: VetPop2023 County Data, 9L
vetpop_county.description: VetPop2023 projection (base 2023-09-30), one row per September 30, 2023-2053, integers rounded per cell; veterans by county (5-digit fips, county_state 'Autauga, AL'), sex and 4 age groups; 781,200 rows: always filter

vetpop_cd118.name: VetPop2023 118th Congressional Districts, 10L
vetpop_cd118.description: VetPop2023 projection (base 2023-09-30), one row per September 30, 2023-2053, integers rounded per cell; veterans by 118th-Congress district (congressional_district_cd 'CD 1'), sex and age (<65, 65+); value column is veteran (singular)

vetpop_cd119.name: VetPop2023 Veteran Population by 119th Congressional Districts: FY 2025 to 2028
vetpop_cd119.description: VetPop2023 projection by 119th-Congress district (cd 'CD 01'), FY2025-2028 only, totals (no sex or age), unrounded decimals

vetpop_visn.name: VetPop2023 Veterans Integrated Services Networks (VISNs), 11L
vetpop_visn.description: VetPop2023 projection (base 2023-09-30), one row per September 30, 2023-2053, integers rounded per cell; veterans by VA health care network (visn, visn_description), sex and 4 age groups; value column is veteran

vetpop_state_fy2026.name: Veteran Population by State: FY2026
vetpop_state_fy2026.description: VetPop2023 projected veterans by state for FY2026 only (state, number); 51 rows: 50 states and Puerto Rico, no DC

vetpop_deaths_county.name: VetPop2023 Projected Deaths by County, FY2024-2075
vetpop_deaths_county.description: VetPop2023 projected veteran deaths by county, wide: one fy2024 ... fy2075 column per fiscal year (county_fips, county_state)

vetpop_est_national.name: VetPop2023 National Estimates 2000 to 2023
vetpop_est_national.description: VetPop2023 back-cast estimates 2000-2023, national, by sex and 4 age groups, wide: one fy2000 ... fy2023 column per fiscal year

vetpop_est_national_age.name: VetPop2023 National Estimates by Sex and Age Groups 2000 to 2023
vetpop_est_national_age.description: VetPop2023 estimates 2000-2023, national, by sex and 15 age groups, wide fy2000 ... fy2023 columns

vetpop_est_state.name: VetPop2023 State Estimates 2000 to 2023
vetpop_est_state.description: VetPop2023 estimates 2000-2023 by state, sex and 4 age groups, wide fy2000 ... fy2023 columns

vetpop_est_state_age.name: VetPop2023 Estimates by State, 15 Age Groups, and Sex: 2000 to 2023
vetpop_est_state_age.description: VetPop2023 estimates 2000-2023 by state, sex and 15 age groups, wide fy2000 ... fy2023 columns

vetpop_est_state_race.name: Veteran Estimates by State, Sex, and Race/Ethnicity: FY 2005 to 2023
vetpop_est_state_race.description: VetPop2023 with ACS 1-year shares: veterans by state (fips, state), sex (F/M), race_ethnicity ('Total' row) and date, FY2005-2023, unrounded decimals

comp_recipients_county_fy2025.name: FY 2025 Disability Compensation Recipients by County
comp_recipients_county_fy2025.description: veterans receiving disability compensation as of 2025-09-30 by county (fips_code), with service-connected rating groups, age groups and sex; blank = suppressed small count

comp_recipients_county_fy2024.name: FY 2024 Disability Compensation Recipients by County
comp_recipients_county_fy2024.description: same as comp_recipients_county_fy2025 for the close of FY2024

comp_recipients_county_fy2023.name: FY 2023 Disability Compensation Recipients by County

pension_recipients_state_fy2025.name: FY 2025 Pension Recipients by State
pension_recipients_state_fy2025.description: veterans receiving VA pension as of 2025-09-30 by state, total and by sex; blank = suppressed

pension_recipients_state_fy2024.name: FY 2024 Pension Recipients by State
pension_recipients_state_fy2024.description: same as pension_recipients_state_fy2025 for the close of FY2024

comp_expenditures_state_fy2024.name: Veteran Compensation Expenditures By State of Residence and Age Group FY 2024
comp_expenditures_state_fy2024.description: VBA: compensation recipients on the rolls and estimated monthly and annual compensation dollars by state and foreign residence, FY2024, ending with a 'Grand Total' row; dollar columns are text like '[$$]3,729,011,236'; age columns compensation_veterans_age (34 and under), _age_1 (35-54), _age_2 (55-74), _age_3 (75+), _age_4 (unknown)

comp_expenditures_state_fy2023.name: Veteran Compensation Expenditures By State of Residence and Age Group FY 2023
comp_expenditures_state_fy2023.description: same as comp_expenditures_state_fy2024 for FY2023 (last age column is compensation_age_unknown)

pension_expenditures_state_fy2024.name: Veteran Pension Expenditures By State of Residence and Age Group FY 2024
pension_expenditures_state_fy2024.description: VBA: veterans pension recipients and estimated monthly and annual pension dollars by state, FY2024, ending with a 'Grand Total' row; dollar columns are text like '[$$]51,471,499.32'; age groups 34 and under, 35-64, 65-74, 75+, unknown

pension_expenditures_state_fy2023.name: Veteran Pension Expenditures By State of Residence and Age Group FY 2023
pension_expenditures_state_fy2023.description: same as pension_expenditures_state_fy2024 for FY2023 (first age column is veterans_pension_age_age)

comp_rolls_pos_state.name: Veterans Receiving Compensation Service Benefits On the Rolls by Period of Service and Residence FY22-FY24
comp_rolls_pos_state.description: compensation recipients by period of service and state or country of residence, FY2022-FY2024 (text values with commas, 'Not included')

pension_pct_state.name: VA Pension Recipients as a Percentage of Veteran Population by State
pension_pct_state.description: percent of veterans receiving VA pension by state, FY2019, 2020, 2021 and 2023 (no FY2022)

hc_comp_users_trend.name: Trend in Percent of Health Care & Disability Compensation Users vs Other Users: FY2010-2025
hc_comp_users_trend.description: share of VA benefit users who use health care or disability compensation vs other programs, FY2010-2025 (fractions, 0.743 = 74.3%)
